subject: Bench harness: accept --context-note flag to wire note→trial task at creation
description:
The bench harness knows which KB note governs each candidate. Currently that link is never recorded — the trial task starts orphaned and relies on RAG to find the note. Fix: pass the note at trial creation time.

Changes to `bench/heldout/run-trial.sh`:
- Add `--context-note <note-key>` optional flag
- When provided, after the bench task is registered in the orchestrator, call `add_dependency` (or the new `wires_to` endpoint) to wire note → trial task
- This means the bench task always has the right note as a DAG dep, regardless of embedding quality

Example usage:
```bash
bash bench/heldout/run-trial.sh \
  --candidate task-transcript \
  --arm on --consult=gated \
  --trial 50 \
  --context-note note-mqa1dtbxirw
```

Also update the bench README/spec to document that each candidate should have a paired context-note key.
